annotations.title: Change some of an app's files

description: Redeploys the app with a few files changed: files maps each path to its new content, or to null to delete it. Every other file stays as it is. expected_deploy_id must be the app's live deploy (from get_app_source or the last deploy result); if someone deployed in between, nothing changes and you are told to read the source again. Builds and type checks like deploy_app.

app.description: The app's slug: the first label of its address (my-app for https://my-app.fuast.com). list_apps shows the slugs you can use.

delete_tables.description: Only when a deploy was refused because the new schema drops tables that hold rows: repeat each table with the exact row count from that error to confirm deleting it.

edit_token.description: The edit_token deploy_app returned when it deployed a preview without an account. It is a secret: keep it in this conversation only.

expected_deploy_id.description: The deploy id your change is based on.

files.description: Changes as {"path": "new content"} to write a file, {"path": null} to delete it.
